scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:00 - 00:00:04:01
Picking a new location for your business
is one of the highest stakes decisions

00:00:04:01 - 00:00:04:20
you'll make.

00:00:04:20 - 00:00:07:20
Get it right
and you've got a profitable new branch.

00:00:08:00 - 00:00:13:02
Get it wrong and you're looking at months
of losses before you can course correct.

00:00:13:23 - 00:00:17:00
The problem is that most expansion
decisions

00:00:17:01 - 00:00:22:09
still rely on gut feeling outdated
reports, or expensive consultants.

00:00:23:06 - 00:00:26:04
In manual research, it doesn't scale.

00:00:26:04 - 00:00:30:04
You can't realistically compare
dozens of cities or neighborhoods by hand

00:00:30:04 - 00:00:33:17
and expect consistent,
objective results quickly.

00:00:34:08 - 00:00:39:16
Today, I'm going to show you how to use
Google Maps scraper to turn Google Maps

00:00:39:16 - 00:00:43:02
into a competitive intelligence engine
for marketing expansion.

00:00:43:20 - 00:00:48:01
You'll be able to analyze thousands
of locations across multiple markets

00:00:48:01 - 00:00:53:12
in hours, not weeks, and make location
decisions backed by real data.

00:00:53:20 - 00:00:55:11
Let's get specific.

00:00:55:11 - 00:00:59:02
Imagine you're on the expansion team
at a European fitness franchise.

00:00:59:13 - 00:01:02:13
You've got budget approval
to open new branches,

00:01:02:13 - 00:01:06:09
but leadership wants data to back
every location decision.

00:01:07:03 - 00:01:10:23
The question isn't whether to expand, it's
where

00:01:11:11 - 00:01:15:22
you need to know how many competing gyms
operating each target area,

00:01:16:04 - 00:01:19:17
how they rated, whether they have gaps
in their service hours,

00:01:19:23 - 00:01:24:01
and where customer demand is high
but options are limited.

00:01:24:20 - 00:01:28:04
Traditionally,
you'd hire a consulting firm to run

00:01:28:04 - 00:01:32:02
this analysis that could cost
tens of thousands and take weeks.

00:01:32:10 - 00:01:35:13
Or you could try tools
like laser eye or side XLS,

00:01:35:22 - 00:01:40:02
but those run into the hundreds of dollars
per month and come loaded with features

00:01:40:02 - 00:01:41:03
you'll never use.

00:01:41:03 - 00:01:45:01
With Google Maps Scraper, you can extract
exactly the data points you need

00:01:45:07 - 00:01:49:09
competitor names, addresses,
coordinates, revenue accounts, average

00:01:49:09 - 00:01:54:01
ratings, price levels, operating hours
for all your target cities.

00:01:54:03 - 00:01:58:08
Then you map that data into a BI tool
like power BI or Google Sheets,

00:01:58:08 - 00:02:03:11
and immediately see which areas have low
gym density and poor competitor ratings.

00:02:04:05 - 00:02:06:06
Those are your opportunities.

00:02:06:06 - 00:02:09:06
And because you can schedule
the actor to run monthly,

00:02:09:07 - 00:02:12:07
you're not just making a one time
decision.

00:02:12:07 - 00:02:16:12
You're building an ongoing view of how
your competitive landscape is shifting.
